name: Eye's ~Anata no Hitomi ni Utsuru Mono~
original_name: Eye’s ～あなたの瞳にうつるもの～
source: It's ordinary and boring school life. There is Asami teacher and three girls to fight for attention and each of girls has her own rival the number of characters increases to 6!
translation: 这是平凡而无聊的校园生活。浅见老师和三名女孩会为争夺关注而展开竞争，而每位女孩又各有一名对手，于是角色总数增加到了六人！
